description: This file defines the implementation of the Code 3 of 9 barcode, including methods for rendering, validation, and internal line pattern calculations.

classes.name: Code3of9Standard
classes.description: A class representing the Code 3 of 9 barcode standard, inheriting from ThickThinBarCode, providing barcode rendering and validation functionalities.

methods.name: ThickThinLines
methods.description: Returns an array of booleans representing the thick/thin pattern for a given character.

methods.name: CalcThinBarWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of thin bars based on the text length and size specifications.

methods.name: CheckCode
methods.description: Validates that the input string contains only valid characters for Code 3 of 9 barcode.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the barcode graphic, including start, stop, and character patterns.

methods.name: RenderNextChar
methods.description: Renders the next character in the barcode text.

methods.name: RenderChar
methods.description: Renders a single character's pattern into the barcode.

methods.name: RenderStart
methods.description: Renders the start pattern of the barcode.

methods.name: RenderStop
methods.description: Renders the stop pattern of the barcode.
